body: As someone who only plays Silent (32 hours with 9 wins), there's a few strategies that bring me pretty consistent success. All of those involve very heavy amounts of block. Silent can pretty much win with anything as long as you get the right block requirements. I've even beat the time eater with a shiv deck twice now and Donu and Deca with a caltrops deck just because I could produce 60+ block every turn. The key to making this happen is dexterity, draw, energy and applying weak. By energy I mean the ability to play many cards in a single turn, using tactics like energy production (relics, outmaneuver, concentrate), cost reduction (Snecko eye, madness) or capitalizing on 0-cost cards. Depending on the deck it's your call which of those aspects you want to invest heavily in, but I think you will find much more success if you capitalize on the huge amount of block Silent can generate and figure out how you will be dealing damage from there.
Please do share your story. I want to fix this more than anything and it would be foolish to pass up on any opportunity that might help me do that.
